title: ERBS Ltd
description: UK roofing contractor site upgraded with real project photography and a structured Our Work gallery — so homeowners see proof, not placeholders.
longDescription: Eastfield Roofing Services needed their website to reflect the quality of jobs they actually complete. Placeholder images were replaced with a full year of real project photos sourced from their Facebook archive, categorized by job type, and presented in a dedicated project gallery.
challenge: The site structure existed, but trust was weak: stock-style placeholders did not match a working roofing contractor with a strong local track record.
solution: Sourced and organized ~12 months of Facebook project photos, matched images to the right service pages, and built an Our Work portfolio gallery.
results: Real project photos live across service pages
Categorized gallery by job type (slate, repairs, full roofs)
Stronger first impression for homeowners comparing local roofers
Site ready to support enquiry conversion
keyFeatures: Real project photography from client Facebook archive
Mobile-friendly proof for local roofing enquiries

title: V1 Campers
description: Complex WooCommerce + PH Bookings work: deposit pricing fixes, 6-week deposit rules, branded balance-payment reminders, and staff-safe Stripe link workflow.
longDescription: V1 Campers needed booking commerce to behave correctly under real hire rules. Fixed deposit total display bugs, enforced a 6-week restriction on £100 deposits, built WP-Cron balance reminders with branded WooCommerce emails, and a no-code order meta box for Stripe links.
challenge: Plugin defaults showed the wrong Pay Full Amount price, near-term hires could still pick a low deposit, and balance reminders needed automation without losing human review.
solution: Custom JS with MutationObserver for deposit UI sync; 6-week deposit lock; WP-Cron daily checks 42 days before hire; custom Woo email class; order meta box for Stripe links.
results: Deposit UI shows real booking totals
£100 deposit blocked inside 6 weeks of hire
Automated balance reminders 42 days before start
Staff can attach Stripe links before send
Branded emails (not WordPress as sender)
keyFeatures: Order meta box for Stripe payment links
seoTitle: V1 Campers — WooCommerce Booking & Deposit Automation
